newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai PTT oil earns 3.6 bln baht from exports.
newsitem.headline: Thai PTT oil earns 3.6 bln baht from exports.

text.p: PTT International, a unit of the state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT), said on Tuesday it exported petroleum and petroleum products during the first quarter worth 3.6 billion baht ($144 million).

Surong Bulakul, senior vice president of PTT International, said the volume included surplus products bidden from local refineries by PTT and international oil trading, apart from its direct sales to China and the Indochinese countries.
The firm gave no comparison figures for sales because this is the first year it has launched export sales in a big way.
PTT International said products from local refineries amounted to 1.18 million barrels and the volume of international trading totalled 1.83 million barrels worth 2.1 billion baht.

It said a total of 73,000 tonnes of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) worth 600 million baht plus 1.2 million barrels of natural gasoline and condensate valued at 700 million baht were exported during the period.
The company earned the remainder of 200 million baht from exporting 21,000 tonnes of benzene and paraxylene.
PTT International, which was established following a major restructuring at PTT in February 1996, is in charge of conducting supply and trading with foreign countries.
